name: app
title: app
description:
Rebuild the Daily Mood Logger into a complete FastAPI + HTML + JavaScript app.

Requirements:
- Homepage at `/` using Jinja2 template with a clean layout.
- Dropdown for mood selection (Happy, Sad, Angry, Neutral, Excited).
- Textbox to write a short note.
- Button to log mood → sends POST /log via fetch() with {mood, note}.
- Below, show a table of the 10 most recent logs from GET /recent.
- “Clear All Logs” button → calls DELETE /clear.
- Store logs in mood_log.json with timestamp.
- Include CSS for soft pastel background, centered content, rounded boxes.
- Include minimal JS to update the list dynamically after logging or clearing.
